collection.title: BMW 2 Series Coupe/Gran Coupe 2014 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 2 Series Coupe 2014 - 2019 requires a 22" wiper blade the drivers side and a 18" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
